youtube_title: The Medium Popcorn Is a TRAP 🍿 Decoy Pricing #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess why the medium popcorn costs almost the same as the large?

It's a decoy. It isn't there to sell, it's there to make the large look cheap. Dan Ariely's famous Economist test: web only $59, print only $125, print + web $125. With the useless print-only option, 84% picked the costly combo. Remove it: only 32% did.

Rule: ignore the middle option. Ask: if only the small one existed, would I buy it?
Moral: The middle option is bait.

Source: Dan Ariely, Predictably Irrational (2008), ch. 1. Popcorn prices in the video are examples.
